justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/FormatFactory.java` and found a 43-line interface with exactly one abstract method, `getFormat(String, String, Locale)`, so it does not show excessive size, many methods, or multiple responsibilities. `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/ExtendedMessageFormat.java` uses it only as a narrow registry hook for custom formats, and `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/ExtendedMessageFormatTest.java` contains simple one-method implementations, reinforcing that this unit is a small cohesive contract rather than an insufficiently modular class.
